instrument.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
instrument.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union (EUR-Lex)

freshness.note: The consolidation is a documentary text, not the authentic legal act.

requirements.locator: Article 2; Article 113 is a separate applicability-date dependency
requirements.interpretation: Keep the operator's applicability determination attributable, versioned and separate from the required-policy inventory; never derive jurisdiction from language or provider.
requirements.criterion: A selected-policy record can retain its origin and revision; the later selection contract can represent applies, declared inapplicability and unresolved facts without deleting the candidate.
requirements.limits: No inference that SETT or any deployment is in scope. The selected consolidation includes amended scope and applicability dates; Article 2(13), Article 113, role classification and other exceptions remain deployment-specific. Missing facts block an affected action only under an explicitly required application policy.

capability.mechanism: The application declares, for each policy, whether it applies, does not apply or is undetermined, with a justification; the declaration is read before any policy runs.
A required policy whose applicability is undetermined blocks the action.

left_to_deployment: Determining whether the regulation applies to the deployment, and in which role.
Applying the dates of application set by Article 113.

requirements.interpretation: Associate an application-defined oversight policy with its source and required review or checkpoint mechanisms. Do not infer a universal prior-approval rule from this provision.
requirements.criterion: Retain the source and requirement revision now; later review/checkpoint batches must verify the application's declared obligation before the relevant controlled effect.
requirements.limits: Metadata does not establish oversight effectiveness, operator competence or safe interruption. High-risk classification and phased application under Article 113 remain deployment-specific. This sample does not implement Article 14(5)'s special case.

capability.mechanism: A policy can declare a restriction on later actions; it holds until a favorable completed review, reported by the application's verifier, lifts it.
Notifications and human reviews with a deadline the application reports are recorded; an overdue report blocks nothing by itself.
Conditions the application declares are verified before the effect; a failed condition blocks it.
Controlled checkpoints inside a handler stop its next part when a condition fails there.
A final gate checks, just before the effect, that nothing it depends on has changed.

left_to_deployment: Ensuring the competence and authority of the people who oversee.
Being able to interrupt the system safely.
Classifying the system as high-risk or not.
